Overall, the domestic box office has seen a significant increase compared to last year.

title: Quote of the day by Gary Oldman
description: Gary Oldman emphasizes that aspiring to be a truly great actor is essential, rather than settling for mediocrity. He describes this ambition as a powerful internal force, much like a constant flame. Throughout his impressive career, he has embraced a variety of complex roles and endured a quest for ongoing improvement.

title: Jonathan Lipnicki returns to the spotlight after 30 years
description: Jonathan Lipnicki re-emerged into the public eye at the recent Los Angeles premiere of 'Primetime', his first such event in two years. After achieving fame as a child actor, he opted for a break to enjoy his teenage experiences. Despite the ebbs and flows in his acting career, Lipnicki actively auditions for new roles.

title: Sitaare Zameen Par: Aamir returns to Japanese theatres
description: Aamir Khan's 'Sitaare Zameen Par' will release in Japan as 'Sitaare! The Miracle Team of Stardust' in spring 2027, marking his first Japanese theatrical release since 'Dangal' in 2018. Geek Pictures announced this on September 25, 2026. The film, directed by R. S. Prasanna, follows a coach mentoring a basketball team of adults with disabilities.

title: In 2024, Robert Downey Jr. co-founded a coffee brand with a mental health mission
description: Robert Downey Jr. has partnered with Craig Dubitsky to launch Happy Products, a coffee brand supporting mental health. The brand collaborates with the National Alliance on Mental Illness to include mental health information on packaging. Each product features resources such as the NAMI helpline number and a QR code for support services. Happy Products aims to normalize discussions around mental health within everyday routines, particularly through coffee consumption.

title: Sylvester Stallone reveals bulimia battle while building his ‘Rocky III’ physique
description: Sylvester Stallone opened up about his battle with bulimia and steroid abuse during the making of the 'Rocky' and 'Rambo' franchises. His relentless pursuit of a perfect physique took a heavy toll on his well-being. The constant demand of performing stunts and staying muscular became increasingly burdensome. A turning point came when he portrayed an overweight role in 'Cop Land', prompting a shift in mindset.

title: Nani says ‘The Paradise’ reactions show the trust and expectations audiences had
description: Nani and director Srikanth Odela delved into the mixed audience reactions following their film, The Paradise. Srikanth shared his astonishment at the polarized views and acknowledged the necessity of time to comprehend them. Anticipating varied responses, Nani highlighted the film's profound impact and distinctive storytelling. They agreed that the strong box office performance demonstrates audience confidence in their collaboration, intending to utilize viewer feedback for enhancing their future projects.

title: Bosco recalls Vivek lesson: Choreographer says he once felt slighted
description: Choreographer Bosco Martis recalled feeling hurt when Vivek Oberoi asked for a creative breakdown before agreeing to a song, post his 'Company' and 'Saathiya' success. Bosco later realised Vivek's approach was justified. Vivek emphasised keeping work separate from friendship. He's known for films like Masti, Omkara, Krrish 3, and recently, Mastiii 4 (2025).

The Centre also reconstituted CBFC with an 18-member board, including Preity Zinta and Pankaj Tripathi.

title: Quote of the day by MrBeast
description: MrBeast, the internet sensation known as Jimmy Donaldson, carved his path to YouTube stardom through years of unwavering commitment. His numerous setbacks were not failures but learning opportunities that paved the way for remarkable achievements. His experience serves as a testament to the importance of perseverance and self-reflection in the creative process. By applying his insights to new ventures, he built a powerful brand that transcends YouTube.

title: Vijay Deverakonda’s ‘Ranabaali’ gets four-part documentary series ahead of release
description: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna will star in the film 'Ranabaali', set for release on October 16, 2026. The film, directed by Rahul Sankrityan, will explore the Madras Famine of 1876-78. A four-part documentary series titled 'Never Forget - The Truth Series' will precede the film's release. Each episode will cover different chapters linked to the film's historical context.

title: Billy Gardell opens up about the health crisis that changed his life
description: Billy Gardell's remarkable health transformation has been shaped by a diabetes diagnosis and the necessity for surgery. After struggling with weight management for years, he discovered that traditional exercise alone wasn’t enough. Following bariatric surgery, he no longer needs diabetes medication and enjoys everyday activities. His family's support proved vital in motivating him towards a healthier lifestyle, highlighting the many steps he took to regain his freedom.

title: Krishna Mukerji chautha ceremony: Bollywood figures mourn playback singer
description: Rani Mukerji's mother, Krishna Mukerji, passed away on September 22 at 75 after a brief illness. Krishna was married to filmmaker Ram Mukherjee, who died in 2017.

After maintaining a private relationship, they joyfully revealed their engagement to loved ones in March 2021. On June 9, 2022, they exchanged vows at a star-studded ceremony. Later that year, they welcomed twin boys, Uyir and Ulagam. The family recently celebrated the boys' fourth birthday, a moment of happiness and togetherness.

The property boasts a spacious seven-bedroom home and remarkable equestrian amenities designed for horse enthusiasts. Acquired by Spielberg in 1999 for just $5.75 million, this estate has undergone significant improvements, with the current price reflecting its enhanced value over the years.
